text: The Frobenius method seeks a solution of the form y = x^r times a power series about x = 0 when x = 0 is:
explanation: Frobenius applies at a regular singular point, where x*p(x) and x^2*q(x) are analytic; the exponent r is fixed by the indicial equation. At an ordinary point an ordinary power series (r = 0) suffices, and at an irregular singular point the method generally fails.
